conservative.rationale: Slow cross-domain transfer and persistent evidence-verification bottlenecks.

central.rationale: Partial transfer from general agent progress, with business-research reliability improving more slowly than the historical software time horizon.

accelerated.rationale: Rapid improvement in long-horizon agents, inference infrastructure, retrieval and verification.

scope: Conditional scenario forecast after a BMA-ARB baseline is observed
rules: Do not issue a numerical dated forecast before at least one valid BMA-ARB run exists.
Do not treat scenario spread as a statistical confidence interval.
Keep the frozen-2026 capability-share forecast separate from annual opportunity-envelope revisions.
Replace these priors with fitted BMA-ARB trends after at least six monthly observations and two frontier-model generations.
